pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-sized, irregular polygonal regions with softened edge gradients. The geometry ranges from sub-rhomboidal to multi-faceted trapezoidal forms with relatively smooth pixel-level transitions between pigmented and non-pigmented areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly connected network of off-white negative space forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes consist primarily of trivalent and tetravalent intersections with relatively consistent pixel thickness across the visible neck and upper flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour visible along the upper neck ridge of the background specimen, representing the mane silhouette against the forest background.
